tagline: Crane NXT is a premier industrial technology company providing proprietary and trusted technology solutions to secure, detect, and authenticate mission-critical assets for government and commercial customers.
hero_kpi_rationale: Consolidated operating margin reflecting the efficiency of the two operating segments (CPI and SAT) and the profitability of core operations following the integration of De La Rue and Antares Vision acquisitions.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Operating margin indicates the company's ability to generate profits from its core operations.
kpis.signal: Measures the profitability of main operations.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by all company activities.
kpis.description: Net sales represent the total consolidated sales from both CPI and SAT segments.

kpis.name: CPI Segment Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income of the Crane Payment Innovations segment as a percentage of its sales.
kpis.description: The CPI segment operating margin demonstrates the stability and efficiency of this business despite a slight revenue decline.
kpis.signal: Profitability indicator for the payment segment.

kpis.name: SAT Segment Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income of the Security and Authentication Technologies segment as a percentage of its sales.
kpis.description: The SAT segment operating margin reflects the integration of De La Rue and OpSec acquisitions as well as associated restructuring charges.
kpis.signal: Profitability indicator for the authentication segment.

kpis.name: SAT Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the Security and Authentication Technologies segment including De La Rue and OpSec acquisitions.
kpis.description: SAT segment growth is primarily driven by the integration of De La Rue (acquired in May 2025) and consolidation of OpSec, expanding the authentication portfolio.
kpis.signal: Significant growth linked to strategic acquisitions.

kpis.name: CPI Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the Crane Payment Innovations segment.
kpis.description: The CPI segment experienced a slight contraction in 2025, primarily affected by variable demand in the automated vending sector.
kpis.signal: Slight decline linked to macroeconomic conditions and reduced demand.

kpis.name: Restructuring Charges
kpis.explanation: Charges related to restructuring and integration of De La Rue and OpSec acquisitions.
kpis.description: 2025 restructuring charges include $12.1M related to DLR/OpSec integration and $4.7M in the CPI segment for cost optimization.
kpis.signal: Integration costs and operational efficiency measures.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.description: Headcount may reflect investments in human capital and operational efficiency.
kpis.signal: Indicator of organization size and growth.

kpis.name: De La Rue Acquisition Impact
kpis.explanation: Strategic acquisition of De La Rue Authentication Solutions for $300 million, completed in May 2025.
kpis.description: De La Rue was combined with OpSec Security to form Crane Authentication within the SAT segment, expanding the authentication portfolio for governments and brands.
kpis.signal: Strategic expansion into authentication and digital security solutions.

kpis.name: Antares Vision Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Multi-phase acquisition of Antares Vision S.p.A., initiated in December 2025 with acquisition of 32.3% for $137.8 million (€117.3 million).
kpis.description: Antares Vision is a global provider of inspection and detection systems for product safety and quality control, as well as traceability and tracking solutions to prevent counterfeiting.
kpis.signal: Expansion into Life Sciences and Food and Beverage markets.

kpis.name: Organic Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Organic sales growth excluding foreign exchange effects and first-year impacts of acquisitions.
kpis.description: 2025 organic sales growth of 0.7% reflects weak demand in the CPI segment and macroeconomic challenges mentioned in risk factors.
kpis.signal: Limited organic growth, impacted by macroeconomic conditions.

kpis.name: Acquisitions Revenue Contribution
kpis.explanation: Additional revenue generated by acquisitions, excluding organic and currency effects.
kpis.description: Acquisitions contributed $133.0 million in additional sales in 2025, representing 8.9% of total growth, primarily related to De La Rue and OpSec consolidation.

risks.title: Macroeconomic fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Macroeconomic fluctuations may have a significant impact on operating results and financial condition. The report explicitly mentions that macroeconomic conditions affect demand, particularly in the CPI vending segment.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity risks are elevated due to the company's dependence on information systems and technology networks.

risks.title: Supplier dependence and supply chain
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on suppliers for certain critical components and raw materials. The report mentions potential disruptions related to tariffs and supply chain conditions.

risks.title: Regulatory and export control risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to government regulations and export control laws. The report notes ongoing monitoring of global trade policies.

risks.title: Competition and variable demand
risks.score_rationale: Demand for the company's products is variable and subject to factors beyond its control, particularly in the CPI vending segment.

risks.title: Acquisition integration risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has completed several major acquisitions (De La Rue in 2025, Antares Vision initiated in 2025) and may encounter difficulties during integration.

risks.title: Intellectual property protection risks
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on intellectual property protection to maintain its competitive position, particularly for micro-optics and authentication technologies.

ai_positioning.summary: CXT does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K/20-F report. The authentication and detection solutions mentioned are not explicitly positioned as AI or machine learning technologies.
